articleTitle: Survey of hardware IoT platforms
publicationTitle: 2016 Third International Scientific-Practical Conference Problems of Infocommunications Science and Technology (PIC S&T)
abstract: in this article are listed the most popular IoT platforms and their performances. This platforms are used to create modern IoT projects in startups, scientific projects and other useful devices for smart house etc. The article formulates basic review of hardware platforms based on user needs.

articleTitle: Strumok stream cipher: Specification and basic properties
publicationTitle: 2016 Third International Scientific-Practical Conference Problems of Infocommunications Science and Technology (PIC S&T)
abstract: STRUMOK is a word-oriented additive stream cipher, where a word in the specification is chosen to be 64 bits. STRUMOK cipher uses some basic design principles from the stream cipher SNOW 2.0. STRUMOK aims at improving SNOW 2.0 both from the security and from the efficiency points of view. Most notably, it uses a more productive keystream generation procedure.

articleTitle: Combinatorial properties of block symmetric ciphers key schedule
publicationTitle: 2016 Third International Scientific-Practical Conference Problems of Infocommunications Science and Technology (PIC S&T)
abstract: We investigate combinatorial properties of the block symmetric ciphers key schedule in the assumption that the cyclic (round) keys are generated randomly, with equal probability and independently of each other. The model of random homogeneous substitution is used for an abstract description of this formation. Analytical expressions allow us to estimate the power of implemented encryption-decryption maps set, obtain estimates of the probability properties of round keys sequences and ratios of the average number of different key sequences to power of different master keys set. The simulation results confirm the accuracy and validity of these analytical expressions.

articleTitle: Anonymous electronic signature method
publicationTitle: 2016 Third International Scientific-Practical Conference Problems of Infocommunications Science and Technology (PIC S&T)
abstract: This work deals with consideration the anonymous electronic signature mechanisms based on algorithms, described in ISO/IEC 14888-3:2014 and national standard DSTU 4145-2002. The security protocol based on these algorithms is tested by the anonymity criterion.

articleTitle: Physical model of pseudorandom codes in multidimensional Euclidean space
publicationTitle: 2016 Third International Scientific-Practical Conference Problems of Infocommunications Science and Technology (PIC S&T)
abstract: The main problems of practical use of pseudorandom codes in modern data transmission systems are considered. The existing methods of generating pseudorandom sequences are analyzed. Physical model of pseudorandom codes in Euclidean space is developed. This model is displayed like carriers of code words in the form of pieces of realization of pseudorandom processes with a limited range.

articleTitle: Post-quantum message authentication cryptography based on error-correcting codes
publicationTitle: 2016 Third International Scientific-Practical Conference Problems of Infocommunications Science and Technology (PIC S&T)
abstract: In this paper we analyse possibilities of application of post-quantum code based signature schemes for message authentication purposes. An error-correcting code based digital signature algorithm is presented. There also shown results of computer simulation for this algorithm in case of Reed-Solomon codes and the estimated efficiency of its software implementation. We consider perspectives of error-correcting codes for message authentication and outline further research directions.

articleTitle: Realization of the remote power management system based on the concept of Internet of Things
publicationTitle: 2016 Third International Scientific-Practical Conference Problems of Infocommunications Science and Technology (PIC S&T)
abstract: This paper represents the implemented model of electronic control system based on the concept of Internet of Things. The current state of information and communication networks, its perspectives and concepts of development were characterized. Components for deploying Internet of Things networks such as communication technology, controllers, reader equipment and identification devices, have been identified and divided into four classes according to their functionality The resulting working prototype is recommended in industrial plants, offices, public and private facilities (“smart” home, etc.) in order to conserve power and remote network management.

articleTitle: The block symmetric ciphers in the post-quantum period
publicationTitle: 2016 Third International Scientific-Practical Conference Problems of Infocommunications Science and Technology (PIC S&T)
abstract: The paper displays the results of the research of symmetric cryptographic transformations that can be applied while using the quantum computing systems, so to say, in post-quantum period. For this purpose, we carried out the analysis and comparative study of the most common cryptographic algorithms that are standardized at the international and national levels, and also examined their ability to provide security services in post-quantum period.

articleTitle: Improvement of the high nonlinear S-boxes generation method
publicationTitle: 2016 Third International Scientific-Practical Conference Problems of Infocommunications Science and Technology (PIC S&T)
abstract: This paper presents improvement of the high nonlinear S-boxes generation method by the appropriate selection of the criteria application order which decreases the required computation power for S-box generation. The proposed modification allows generation of a byte S-box with nonlinearity 104, algebraic immunity 3 and maximum of difference distribution table 8 within approximately 30 minutes of a single PC running time.

articleTitle: Study of mobile device wireless control technology in the visible range of the electromagnetic radiation
publicationTitle: 2016 Third International Scientific-Practical Conference Problems of Infocommunications Science and Technology (PIC S&T)
abstract: The analysis widespread in robotics technology for wireless data transmission, the technology of using the optical channel for the exchange of information between different devices.

articleTitle: The solution to the problem of the QoS characteristics definition for self-similar traffic serviced by the W/M/1 QS
publicationTitle: 2016 Third International Scientific-Practical Conference Problems of Infocommunications Science and Technology (PIC S&T)
abstract: The problem of QoS characteristics definition for self-similar traffic for queuing system of the type W/M/1 using the Weibull distribution is considered. To solve this problem, a transformation of Laplace-Stieltjes is applied. The values of service quality characteristics for self-similar traffic QS W/M/1 such as: the average time of packets delay, the average number of requirements in QS and the length of the packet queue are obtained.

articleTitle: Load balancing routing in Time-Sensitive Networks
publicationTitle: 2016 Third International Scientific-Practical Conference Problems of Infocommunications Science and Technology (PIC S&T)
abstract: In the research the load balancing routing model in Time-Sensitive Networks is proposed. The novelty of the solution is a type of optimality criterion, the use of which minimizes the circuit delays. The proposed solution is compromise in terms of computational implementation as compared to the previously known models, in which the equality of the circuit delays of packets were considered as limitations, rather than optimality criterion.

articleTitle: Organization of secure multipath routing
publicationTitle: 2016 Third International Scientific-Practical Conference Problems of Infocommunications Science and Technology (PIC S&T)
abstract: Method of data segmentation and transferring via disjoint ways for providing secure connections between nodes in computer network. This method purposed as tool for reduce the chance of information interception.

articleTitle: Analysis models of collection data in wireless sensor networks
publicationTitle: 2016 Third International Scientific-Practical Conference Problems of Infocommunications Science and Technology (PIC S&T)
abstract: The article analyzes the different models of collecting information from wireless sensor networks. The article examined the data collection model based on a schedule that is suitable for the monitoring parameters. We also consider the model of data collection on request, model data collection event, the adaptive model of information gathering, as well as hybrid model information collection allows to combine several models for a particular purpose of a WSN work.

articleTitle: Chua's circuits synchronization as inverse dynamic's problem solution
publicationTitle: 2016 Third International Scientific-Practical Conference Problems of Infocommunications Science and Technology (PIC S&T)
abstract: The secure data transmission is one of the chaotic systems usages. The paper deals with the synthesis of nonlinear control for the slave Chua's circuit while one can use master-slave chaotic transmission technique. The benefits of proposed method are shown.

articleTitle: The general principles of electromagnetic compatibility improving with microsystem technology using
publicationTitle: 2016 Third International Scientific-Practical Conference Problems of Infocommunications Science and Technology (PIC S&T)
abstract: This paper presents a common bases of assurance electromagnetic compatibility by use of microelectromechanical systems (MEMS) components. Some parameters of microsystem technology and devices fabricated on this technology basis are analyzed.

articleTitle: Calculation of distributed system imbalance in condition of multifractal load
publicationTitle: 2016 Third International Scientific-Practical Conference Problems of Infocommunications Science and Technology (PIC S&T)
abstract: The method of calculating distributed system imbalance based on the calculation of node system load was proposed in the work. Calculation of node system load is carried out by calculating the average coefficient of utilization of CPU, memory, bandwidth of each system node, taking into account multifractal properties of input data flows. The simulation of the proposed method for different multifractal parameters was conducted. The simulation showed that the characteristics of multifractal traffic have a considerable effect on the system imbalance. Using the proposed method allows to distribute requests across the servers so that the deviation of the load servers from the average value was minimal, which allows to get higher system performance metrics and faster processing flows.

articleTitle: Methods of detecting of unknown signals in cognitive radio networks
publicationTitle: 2016 Third International Scientific-Practical Conference Problems of Infocommunications Science and Technology (PIC S&T)
abstract: This work considers methods to detect unknown signals in cognitive radio networks. These methods can be applied when taking decision about presence of a signal in the frequency channel when monitoring radio spectrum. The problem of uncertainty can appear when monitoring spectrum. A way of overcoming a priori uncertainty that arises when monitoring the radio spectrum is proposed.

articleTitle: The ways of creation and use of telecommunication systems in the terahertz band transport distribution 5G mobile networks
publicationTitle: 2016 Third International Scientific-Practical Conference Problems of Infocommunications Science and Technology (PIC S&T)
abstract: The results of research of the main trends and prospects of transport distribution networks development (Mobile backhaul) and the possibilities of using fixed telecommunication systems of terahertz band wireless communication in the framework of building mobile networks 5G are shown. Described designed and experimentally investigated terahertz range radio communication (130-134GHz) with application to build ultrahigh rate (over 1 Gbit/s) transport distribution networks.

articleTitle: Detecting third-party user trackers with cookie files
publicationTitle: 2016 Third International Scientific-Practical Conference Problems of Infocommunications Science and Technology (PIC S&T)
abstract: Nowadays, privacy violations caused by third party services are usually addressed with blacklist approaches. Those approaches have limitation, as they are hard to maintain and need to be frequently updated to provide relevant information. Knowing these limitations, we study ability to identify third-party web trackers having corpus of http request between web resources and associated cookies. Cookies are one of the most popular and easy to use mechanisms to link same user visiting different domains. We propose a method for automatic identification of web-tracking requests, which detects 95% of third-party trackers. The proposed method successfully works with known services and is able to detect previously unseen trackers. To evaluate the proposed technique we artificially collected and then analyzed corpus of internet traffic where we found significant amount of shared cookies across different domains.

articleTitle: Next generation optical access based on N-OFDM with decimation
publicationTitle: 2016 Third International Scientific-Practical Conference Problems of Infocommunications Science and Technology (PIC S&T)
abstract: The article deals with convergent solutions “radio over an optics” on the basis of N-OFDM. To comply with NG PON2 provides the possibility of rapid change in signal between OFDM, OFDMA or N-OFDM. To reduce the computational load on the segment of digital optical network proposed a distributed digital signal processing with low rates of digitization by using decimation operations.

articleTitle: Using the Support Vector Regression method for telecommunication networks monitoring
publicationTitle: 2016 Third International Scientific-Practical Conference Problems of Infocommunications Science and Technology (PIC S&T)
abstract: This paper is about possibility of using the support vector regression method for telecommunication networks monitoring. The paper defines a role of regression analysis in the formation of the correlations between telecommunication networks quality parameters. An example of using the regression analysis by support vector machine with scikit-learn implementation is given.

articleTitle: Method for classification of the computational problems on the basis of the multifractal division of the complexity classes
publicationTitle: 2016 Third International Scientific-Practical Conference Problems of Infocommunications Science and Technology (PIC S&T)
abstract: This paper proposes the method of the multifractal division of the computational complexity classes, which is formalized by introducing the special equivalence relations on these classes. Exposing the self-similarity properties of the complexity classes structure, this method allows performing the accurate classification of the problems and demonstrates the capability of adaptation to the new advances in the computational complexity theory.

articleTitle: Research of hierarchical coordination method of inter-area routing in telecommunication network
publicationTitle: 2016 Third International Scientific-Practical Conference Problems of Infocommunications Science and Technology (PIC S&T)
abstract: The improvement of the scalability of routing decisions is quite relevant in modern telecommunication networks. In this regard, effective approach is associated with the implementation of hierarchical routing. This involves carrying out a structural and functional decomposition of the network, based on the introduction and supporting of multi-level routing decisions. However, the existing protocol implementation hierarchical routing does not contribute to maximization of the scalability of routing decisions because that only applied structural hierarchy and functional aspects are not involved. In this paper the method of hierarchical inter-domain routing based on the goal coordination principle was supposed.

articleTitle: Approaches and algorithms of virtual telecommunication networks analysis in UNetLab environment
publicationTitle: 2016 Third International Scientific-Practical Conference Problems of Infocommunications Science and Technology (PIC S&T)
abstract: This article considers the basic methods of telecommunication networks modelling, along with the relevant software tools. The expediency of using UNetLab, a new software product for simulation modelling, has been proven. This software is used for the creation and analysis of virtual laboratory-oriented experimental testing benches of telecommunication networks. The article formulates general basic comparative characteristics of competing software solutions: GNS3, Cisco VIRL, UNetLab. Principles of using the UNetLab network simulation product and developing telecommunication technologies have been defined.

articleTitle: The technical invariance of piezoresonance devices of the infocommunication systems
publicationTitle: 2016 Third International Scientific-Practical Conference Problems of Infocommunications Science and Technology (PIC S&T)
abstract: The paper discusses the issues of technical invariance piezoresonance devices of infocommunication systems based on the use of multifrequency functional-algorithmic methods.

articleTitle: Proactive spectrum handoff performance evaluation model for Cognitive Radio
publicationTitle: 2016 Third International Scientific-Practical Conference Problems of Infocommunications Science and Technology (PIC S&T)
abstract: In this paper considered spectrum mobility techniques for cognitive radio that based on spectrum sensing. Cognitive Radio (CR) is the newest technology to make the secondary users to make use of licensed spectrum in the opportunistic manner. In the proposed structure, politics of switching channel and a proactive spectrum handoff protocol are let cognitive users use a channel before a primary user occupy it to avoid unwanted interference. Network coordination techniques for cognitive users are also included into the spectrum handoff protocol design to realize channel collision. In the reactive spectrum handoff type, secondary users transmit a packet without predicting the availability of the current channel at the moment when a frame ends. Here is compared the capacity of proposed proactive spectrum handoff scheme with the reactive spectrum handoff type. Proactive spectrum handoff always shows better performance than reactive spectrum handoff in terms of highest capacity and lower collision rate.

articleTitle: IoT device for object's power remote control
publicationTitle: 2016 Third International Scientific-Practical Conference Problems of Infocommunications Science and Technology (PIC S&T)
abstract: This paper represents the characteristic of current state of information technologies. In addition, it provides with the comparative analysis of wireless technologies and proves the relevance of the issues of the Internet of Things. Moreover, it describes the built working prototype of a device for remote power management, which will find its practical application at businesses, offices, data centers and in private homes and reduce energy costs.

articleTitle: Polarization multiplexing modulation in fiber-optic communication lines
publicationTitle: 2016 Third International Scientific-Practical Conference Problems of Infocommunications Science and Technology (PIC S&T)
abstract: The possible losses are analyzed in prospective method of coherent polarization multiplexing. The losses associated with fully polarized and non-polarized components are considered. The adaptive method for compensation of non-polarized components is recommended. To eliminate the distortion caused by the rotation of the polarization plane of the received signals it is recommended to use circular polarizations.

articleTitle: Flexible backhaul architecture for densely deployed 5G small cells based on OWTDMA network
publicationTitle: 2016 Third International Scientific-Practical Conference Problems of Infocommunications Science and Technology (PIC S&T)
abstract: Tremendous increasing of demands in mobile networks introduces a set of new challenges for future 5G networks. Although, network densification has a huge potential to increase network capacity, backhaul channels are still a bottleneck in this chain. In this paper, we have proposed a new approach for optical backhaul based on OWTDMA network. The novelty of proposed approach is in time-wavelength resource grid, which enables fine grained bandwidth allocation. Proposed solution improves the flexibility and scalability of 5G heterogeneous network and may be implemented in combination with other backhaul technologies such as Ethernet and wireless link.

articleTitle: The development of a process planning model of rational modular composition of the information protection systems
publicationTitle: 2016 Third International Scientific-Practical Conference Problems of Infocommunications Science and Technology (PIC S&T)
abstract: The analysis showed that modern approaches to information protection organization do not fully ensure the fulfillment of the requirements for the protection of information. Critical situation in the information security sphere is compounded by the use of the global network for external and internal electronic transactions of the enterprise and the emergence of previously unknown types of destructive information impacts. Therefore, for the successful use of modern information technologies it is necessary to manage effectively not only the network, but also the security of the network. The system that implements management of information security needs to work offline, it is also necessary to develop a process model of rational planning of the modular structure of the system of information protection (SIP) and the method of forming a rational complex of means of protection. Three-tier security model is proposed, which satisfies all the conditions of its development, operation and improvement.

articleTitle: Analysis of quality of service parameters in IP-networks
publicationTitle: 2016 Third International Scientific-Practical Conference Problems of Infocommunications Science and Technology (PIC S&T)
abstract: In this paper a method of evaluating connection quality of IP-networks is considered. The mathematical model of the functioning of the network was made and the estimation of the quality parameters of its work for various values of subscriber traffic. In particular, the algorithm of calculating the delay time of the packet transmission network was made when using the quality assurance mechanisms IntServ and DiffServ, and comparison of their efficiency, depending on the number of network users.

articleTitle: Routing tensor model presented in the basis of interpolar paths and internal node pairs
publicationTitle: 2016 Third International Scientific-Practical Conference Problems of Infocommunications Science and Technology (PIC S&T)
abstract: The routing tensor model in the basis of interpolar paths and internal node pairs with the guarantees by the packet rate and end-to-end delay is presented. The research demonstrated that the guarantees is provided for all paths in realization of the routing tensor model. The use of specified coordinate system facilitates compliance with the requirements for the packet end-to-end delay, i.e. average delays along different paths are not exceed the acceptable value.

articleTitle: Model of frequency and time resource allocation WiMAX with taking into account the defined priorities
publicationTitle: 2016 Third International Scientific-Practical Conference Problems of Infocommunications Science and Technology (PIC S&T)
abstract: The results of development a mathematical model for transmission rate allocation downlink technology WiMAX. The novelty of the proposed model is possible preventive limit transmission rate allocated to the service flows of the user stations in the downlink by using the WiMAX technology linear or linear-quadratic objective function. Using the mathematical model is directed to allocation between subscriber stations of a time-frequency resource of the downlink, which in turn improves the conditions in the electromagnetic frequency range used. The influence of the priority request rate used in the model, the nature of the possible failures.

articleTitle: A network load balancing algorithm for overlay-based SDN solutions
publicationTitle: 2016 Third International Scientific-Practical Conference Problems of Infocommunications Science and Technology (PIC S&T)
abstract: Overlay solutions of SDN-based networks became very popular. Controller as a centralized management devices gather information about network topology and current network state. Overlay network have a lot benefits however the using of classical traffic engineering principles for traffic management in Software-Defined Network is becoming problem. The physical network does not automatically adapt to the changes. As the overlay-based networks grow and requires more resources. The management mechanism - network load balancing algorithm - that take into account centralized structure and heterogeneous traffic nature of Software-Defined Network is proposed in the paper.

articleTitle: Information protection of data processing center against cyber attacks
publicationTitle: 2016 Third International Scientific-Practical Conference Problems of Infocommunications Science and Technology (PIC S&T)
abstract: In this article, the most essential aims on information protection of data processing centers in more flexible way to provide the necessary level of security of the existing environment of development and dissemination of cyber-attacks, which should be easily scaled to support any of its changes in the future, also in this paper Formation of competitive information security of data processing center are analyzed Special attention is paid to avoidance of unauthorized access to information, its blocking, giving, destruction, dissemination, modification, copying, as well as ensuring functioning of data processing centers in a normal mode, in compliance with limit values of design parameters, execution of the target functions of data processing centers.

articleTitle: Research on the efficiency of optical resources utilization for OLS networks
publicationTitle: 2016 Third International Scientific-Practical Conference Problems of Infocommunications Science and Technology (PIC S&T)
abstract: In this paper, the general principle of OLS technology is described in details. Two types of transmission were described: payload and labels transmission. We have assessed the problem of effective size of data unit while taking into account the network parameters such as network delay, efficiency of channels utilization and power consumption. The main approaches to improve the efficiency of channels utilization have been investigated. New mathematical model to determine the efficiency of channels utilization has been proposed and main equations have been derived to estimate the network parameters.

articleTitle: Employment of phase characteristics of user voice signal in authentication systems
publicationTitle: 2016 Third International Scientific-Practical Conference Problems of Infocommunications Science and Technology (PIC S&T)
abstract: In modern society the crucial role belongs to electronic telecommunications, due to which information and financial exchanges between organizations of different forms of property and individuals is performed. Therefore, problems of secure exchange of various resources acquire particular relevance. However, password authentication of users, which now prevails in practical applications, is not able to withstand criticism. Static biometric features of users (facial appearance, fingerprints and iris), which had been tried in different access systems, didn't meet the expectations. Therefore, much attention is currently given to research in the field of voice authentication systems. The object of research is the process of digital signal processing in voice authentication systems. The purpose of research is to improve the quality of voice authentication procedures due to the calculation and analysis of the phase characteristics of digital signal registration materials. The proposed procedure allows dividing the analyzed sequence into the noise sequence and the sequence containing a user voice signal, as well as improving the quality of speech recognition and speaker identification tasks.

articleTitle: Approximation of distributions in the problems of the analysis of self-similar traffic
publicationTitle: 2016 Third International Scientific-Practical Conference Problems of Infocommunications Science and Technology (PIC S&T)
abstract: The analysis of characteristics of nodes of the multiservice communication networks modelled by the G/G/1 systems when processing the modern traffic is the important technical task. In the assumption of independence of intervals of time between requests and independence of intervals of time of processing of the request in system the analysis of wait time of the request in queue can be realized on the basis of the solution of an integrable equation of Lindley by a spectral method. For use of a spectral method often resort to approximation of the distributions used in the G/G/1 system with the heavy tails characteristic of the modern traffic, the amounts of the fading exponents (or if it works well - the hyperexponential distributions). However approximation by the amounts of the fading exponents is rather difficult for the distributions containing the sections “ascending” from zero to some maximum and is, as a rule, executed with unacceptably big error. The method of the spectral solution of the equation of Lindley offered in operation the selects functions for approximation of distributions, the essence of which is that the “ascending” sections of distributions are approximated by polynomials of a small order, and the “falling-down” sections (from the negative derivative) - the amount of the fading exponents with small number of items in the amount is based on use. At the same time the analysis of wait time of the request in queue is consolidated to the numerical solution of the linear algebraic equation. Efficiency of a method is shown on the example of research of system W/P/1, where W - Weibull's distribution, P - Pareto's distribution.

Author Keywords: the average waiting time in the queue for the packet
approximation by the sum of exponents

articleTitle: Microcloud-based architecture of management system for IoT infrastructures
publicationTitle: 2016 Third International Scientific-Practical Conference Problems of Infocommunications Science and Technology (PIC S&T)
abstract: The Internet of Things (IoT) is an emerging technology that is considered by industry and academy as a global infrastructure for the information society in today's digital world. IoT is implemented now in several ecosystems to improve economic indicators and productivity of enterprises, and also to improve the quality of consumer's lives. Thus a development of new architectures and approaches for IoT infrastructure management is needed. In this article the authors propose an approach to develop the Microcloud-based IoT infrastructure architecture based on decomposition-compensation approach [1] to provide the desired quality of IT services with rational use of IT resources. Efficiency of IT infrastructure management can be estimated by the quality of services and the management costs. The main goal of this article is to develop an architecture of management system for IoT infrastructures.

articleTitle: Mathematical model of the process of communicating real time traffic in telecommunication network channel
publicationTitle: 2016 Third International Scientific-Practical Conference Problems of Infocommunications Science and Technology (PIC S&T)
abstract: The mathematical model of the process of communicating real time traffic in telecommunication network channel with commutation of packets, which is based on exponential distribution of the moments of starting communicating and duration of communicating real time streams, is set forth in the article. Using the pro-posed model allows researching, by virtue of imitation, the process of dynamic change of the real time traffic intensity in telecommunication network channel with commutation of packets.

articleTitle: Modified discrete chaotic map based on Chebyshev polynomial
publicationTitle: 2016 Third International Scientific-Practical Conference Problems of Infocommunications Science and Technology (PIC S&T)
abstract: The modified discrete chaotic map based on Chebyshev polynomial is proposed for the design of chaotic signal code constructions. The result can be used for the design of multi-channel chaotic data transmission systems of special purpose.

articleTitle: The application SAP® ERP principles for the development and implementation of corporate integrated information system for SME
publicationTitle: 2016 Third International Scientific-Practical Conference Problems of Infocommunications Science and Technology (PIC S&T)
abstract: The article suggests using the SAP® ERP principles for the design of corporate integrated information system for SME. The content and use of information resources is justified from the standpoint of human health protection, taking into account international standards.

articleTitle: An analysis of multimedia traffic in the MPLS network in ns2 simulator
publicationTitle: 2016 Third International Scientific-Practical Conference Problems of Infocommunications Science and Technology (PIC S&T)
abstract: The study presents the results of self-similar traffic effect on the performance quality indicators in the MPLS network using ns2 simulator. Multimedia 4G network traffic and IPTV-traffic were used as the test traffics. The statistical structure of the multimedia traffic was studied. There were determined probability laws of intervals of admission packages for service and probability time distribution for maintenance packages in the system to handle multimedia traffic 4G networks and IPTV-traffic at the access layer.

articleTitle: Research the efficiency and feasibility of circular polarization in the tropospheric radio link
publicationTitle: 2016 Third International Scientific-Practical Conference Problems of Infocommunications Science and Technology (PIC S&T)
abstract: The possibility of using circular polarization in tropospheric radio link is considered. The effectiveness of different independent states of orthogonal dual polarization at emission and at reception of radio waves is investigated.

articleTitle: Analysis of intervals between traffic packets on the Software Defined Networks depending on the TCP window size
publicationTitle: 2016 Third International Scientific-Practical Conference Problems of Infocommunications Science and Technology (PIC S&T)
abstract: This article is about the impact of TCP-window size in the numerical characteristics of intervals between packets We consider raw moments from the first to third of the time intervals. Experiments were carried out on the virtual system deployed using OpenNebula platform on physical servers. We consider two cases: software defined network with OpenFlow protocol support and traditional network without OpenFlow protocol.: Software defined network built on POX controller and the physical OpenFlow Switch.

articleTitle: A method of resource distribution analysis of NFV technological solution based on formal grammar and languages
publicationTitle: 2016 Third International Scientific-Practical Conference Problems of Infocommunications Science and Technology (PIC S&T)
abstract: The paper is devoted to solving the problem of developing new and improving existing methods of NFV technological solutions analysis on the earlier stages of developing process. A method of analysis functional and non functional requirements of NFV infrastructure realization is proposed. The proposed method bases on mathematical modelling approach. E-network is use as tool for NFV behavioural modelling. The regular formal grammar is use for analysis such properties as reachability, boundedness, liveness, and persistence of E-network of NFV realization model. The algorithm of P-type language generation is proposed in the paper.

articleTitle: Signal restoration by means of blind deconvolution based on optimization with wavelet transformation
publicationTitle: 2016 Third International Scientific-Practical Conference Problems of Infocommunications Science and Technology (PIC S&T)
abstract: An implementation of blind deconvolution algorithm based on multistart optimization method in the wavelet transform domain is shown. The results of simulation confirm the increased likelihood of convergence to a global optimum for determining the filter coefficients for the blind deconvolution problem solutions with help of this optimization method.

articleTitle: The numerical method for analysis of arbitrary type queuing systems application
publicationTitle: 2016 Third International Scientific-Practical Conference Problems of Infocommunications Science and Technology (PIC S&T)
abstract: The Gauss-Kristoffel method for numerical solving the integral Lindley equation is considered in the article. The algorithm of the mean length of the path and the buffer size for the network node represented as the queuing system (QS) type G/G/1 has been worked out. The algorithm is implemented in Matlab system. The results of the algorithm and the previous known analytical results are compared.

articleTitle: Prioritization of network traffic to improve VoIP traffic quality
publicationTitle: 2016 Third International Scientific-Practical Conference Problems of Infocommunications Science and Technology (PIC S&T)
abstract: This paper presents information about multi-access network and comparing a few technologies to provide the best quality of service. The paper provides a description of the basis for modeling a multi-access network. The models involved in the article take into condition an ability of setting priorities to a number of elected traffic classes. Solving the problem of prioritizing network traffic can increase the quality of VoIP. As part of this work is the analysis of network traffic management tools. There will be pilot study compared some popular network traffic management tools and will develop practical recommendations for improving the quality of VoIP.

articleTitle: Default gateway protection scheme in fault-tolerant IP routing
publicationTitle: 2016 Third International Scientific-Practical Conference Problems of Infocommunications Science and Technology (PIC S&T)
abstract: The default gateway protection scheme in fault-tolerant IP routing is proposed in the given paper. In solving the technological problem of the fault-tolerant IP routing, it is necessary to solve either mixed integer nonlinear programming problem during minimization of the object function, or nonlinear programming problem with limitations defined. The proposed model also provides the support of load balancing functions on the virtual router interfaces and fault-tolerant routing in the core network. The use of the model for primary and backup routes provides consistency in solving such important tasks as defining the default gateway and routing in transport network allowing to increase availability and fault-tolerance in communications system in a whole.

articleTitle: Modelling of the phase portraits of noise for identification of electronic devices
publicationTitle: 2016 Third International Scientific-Practical Conference Problems of Infocommunications Science and Technology (PIC S&T)
abstract: The article is devoted to modeling phase portraits of the noise of electronic devices. Analysis of the noise temporal characteristics confirms their fractal nature. Parameters of phase portraits of spectral noise components give the chance the electronic devices authentication. Oscillator model makes it possible to estimate the parameters of phase portraits.

articleTitle: Investigation of simple Denial-of-Service attacks
publicationTitle: 2016 Third International Scientific-Practical Conference Problems of Infocommunications Science and Technology (PIC S&T)
abstract: Methods and ways to perform denial-of-service attack are analyzed and classified in this work. Famous Denial-of-Service attack classifications are reviewed and analyzed. New elements of modern DoS attack classification are proposed.

articleTitle: The concept of services assurance in heterogeneous service-oriented systems
publicationTitle: 2016 Third International Scientific-Practical Conference Problems of Infocommunications Science and Technology (PIC S&T)
abstract: This paper surveys a new and comprehensive concept of services assurance in distributed heterogeneous service-oriented systems. A vertical decomposition of the service delivery is proposed for these systems. The mathematical model of request transmission process is developed.

articleTitle: Using passive optical devices for the protection of information in the optical communication lines
publicationTitle: 2016 Third International Scientific-Practical Conference Problems of Infocommunications Science and Technology (PIC S&T)
abstract: Principles of additional coding optical linear code for protection of information are proposed. Using low-cost passive optical components for optical masking linear codes significantly improves reliability of information security, compared with the use of active equipment.

articleTitle: Researching the requirements from different user groups to Telecommunications Network
publicationTitle: 2016 Third International Scientific-Practical Conference Problems of Infocommunications Science and Technology (PIC S&T)
abstract: Paper is devoted to the research the requirements from different user groups to Telecommunications Network. Based on the proposed approach to creating a model of user requirements change to TN there has been developed expert system, the result of which is to solve the problem of forecasting, which is deciding on belonging to a particular class of network based on accumulated statistics Requirements for services, provided by the network at each moment of time, should be a mandatory element of input data regardless of the network design's goal. Therefore research of quality of users service by the network is given in the paper.

articleTitle: Result research model of scheduling block allocation in downlink LTE
publicationTitle: 2016 Third International Scientific-Practical Conference Problems of Infocommunications Science and Technology (PIC S&T)
abstract: We apply the result of the model of time and frequency resource scheduling in downlink LTE development. The given model is directed upon securing the wireless network users being served by the allocation to user equipment required transmission rates. We completed comparative analysis of the offered model with existing methods from the point of view of securing the common productivity of downlink, level of bandwidth balancing, possibility of allocation to users equipment required transmission rate.

articleTitle: Scalability improvement of the hierarchical queue management solutions on network routers interfaces
publicationTitle: 2016 Third International Scientific-Practical Conference Problems of Infocommunications Science and Technology (PIC S&T)
abstract: In this paper the approach of the scalability improvement of the hierarchical queue management solutions on telecommunication network routers interfaces is presented. Decision is based on usage of hierarchical goal coordination method, in which was proposed usage of the quadratic optimality criterion. It allows ensuring a more balanced queues load that helped to reduce the number of coordination iterations introduced to prevent interface overloading.

articleTitle: Alternate backhaul network solution for implementation of Long Term Evolution technology
publicationTitle: 2016 Third International Scientific-Practical Conference Problems of Infocommunications Science and Technology (PIC S&T)
abstract: Organizational issues of the backhaul network using Long Term Evolution technology are considered. Backhaul connections for different network segments are analyzed. A model of the backhaul network using Multiprotocol Label Switching technology is proposed to form the transport basis for existing networks. The bandwidth and transporting performance of the network is estimated.

articleTitle: Optical field distribution for fibers with diverse index profile under transverse illumination
publicationTitle: 2016 Third International Scientific-Practical Conference Problems of Infocommunications Science and Technology (PIC S&T)
abstract: The new testing method of cascade fibers geometric parameters is considered. The method for observing the junction plane with the use of interference phenomenon is offered.

articleTitle: Approach for LTE EPS network planning with self-similar traffic
publicationTitle: 2016 Third International Scientific-Practical Conference Problems of Infocommunications Science and Technology (PIC S&T)
abstract: This paper proposes an approach to solve the problem of LTE EPS network parametric synthesis taking into account self-similar properties of multiservice traffic. The problem is solved with the known source data such as network topology, traffic routes, statistical data on the demand for information and communication services. The article proposes the calculation expressions to determine the parameters of multiservice self-similar traffic coming into the network, as well as aggregation of in different network elements. The solution is based on the representation of self-similar traffic as of fractal Brownian motion model and calculation expressions Offed by Norros. The proposed method in the paper was compared with the method based on the classical model of a Poisson flow. The experimental procedure is to calculate the parameters of the network by both methods and then checking the results of calculations using the simulation model.

articleTitle: Evaluation of SDN network scalability with different management level structure
publicationTitle: 2016 Third International Scientific-Practical Conference Problems of Infocommunications Science and Technology (PIC S&T)
abstract: Evaluation of network scalability, based on the concept of SDN, is an important task in the design of a new or expansion of existing network architecture. Therefore, different structures of management level were considered and the mathematical model of SDN network was built for these structures in the work. Structure components models of SDN network were considered: data level model, flow initiate model, controller model. Different structures of management level were also considered: centralized, local decentralized, global decentralized, hierarchical and alternative approach of management level building. The results of work can be used for further research of the basic principles of SDN network and fragments building of real networks using software Mininet.

articleTitle: Tradeoff between energy saving and quality of service in IP-over-WDM networks
publicationTitle: 2016 Third International Scientific-Practical Conference Problems of Infocommunications Science and Technology (PIC S&T)
abstract: Energy saving and quality of service are the most popular but contradictory criteria for resource allocation in IP-over-WMD network. Establishing of direct lightpath according to bypass architecture of IP-over-WMD network becomes reasonable when arriving traffic exceeds some threshold while under the threshold traffic have to be routed via compound path if it exists. On the other hand compound path leads to growing end-to-end delay.

articleTitle: Minimization process of the total weighted holding time in a P2P network
publicationTitle: 2016 Third International Scientific-Practical Conference Problems of Infocommunications Science and Technology (PIC S&T)
abstract: Well-known systemic quality criteria: QoS and QoE directly depend on quality of service tasks fulfillment, however, do not always allow to obtain the solution in full. That is why, many papers addressing research of peer-to-peer networks are very specific [1,230]. Our objective is to attempt to obtain a systemic solution, optimal for a delay minimum criterion upon service completion subject to a number of standard restrictions.

articleTitle: An adaptive algorithm for detecting and preventing attacks in telecommunication networks
publicationTitle: 2016 Third International Scientific-Practical Conference Problems of Infocommunications Science and Technology (PIC S&T)
abstract: This article proposed method for monitoring threats preparing attacks on the telecommunications network and to prevent opportunities for their implementation. The method is based on monitoring the implementation of states in the functioning of the network components, vulnerability assessment and determination of the facts of preparation intruder attacks (monitoring risks of attacks) by finding the warning function on a given interval of time.

articleTitle: Determining of the photonic-crystal fibers mode field size at his near field image
publicationTitle: 2016 Third International Scientific-Practical Conference Problems of Infocommunications Science and Technology (PIC S&T)
abstract: This paper presents a method for determining of the maximum diameter of the photonic-crystal fiber mode field. If carrying out the alignment of these two fibers when connecting considers the rotation angle around of the longitudinal axis, it will reduce losses at the junction.

articleTitle: Analytic hierarchy process for choosing the self-organization algorithm for wireless sensor network
publicationTitle: 2016 Third International Scientific-Practical Conference Problems of Infocommunications Science and Technology (PIC S&T)
abstract: In wireless sensor networks (WSNs) there is an important task of self-organizing networks. There are many different algorithms for self-organization of such networks. This choice determines the relevance of pre-emptive self-algorithm network with the additional information obtained from experts. In the article features of practical application of the analytic hierarchy process are considered to select a preferred algorithm for self-organization in wireless sensor networks.

articleTitle: Methods of femtocells planning using methods of packaging optimization
publicationTitle: 2016 Third International Scientific-Practical Conference Problems of Infocommunications Science and Technology (PIC S&T)
abstract: A method of optimizing the spatial deployment of femtocells using packing methods is proposed. Based on the method of joining the single femtocell access points, an algorithm for finding and removing potential nested containers has been built.

articleTitle: Data-driven pseudonondeterministic hashing constructions
publicationTitle: 2016 Third International Scientific-Practical Conference Problems of Infocommunications Science and Technology (PIC S&T)
abstract: The conception of the pseudonondeterministic cryptography is considered. Multiplied data-driven pseudonondeterministic hash constructions, which provide infeasibility increasing against generic attacks based on the multicollision designing, were proposed. The estimations of the infeasibility increasing were presented. The instances of the data-driven pseudonondeterministic hashing methods, which could be designed using the proposed approach, were presented.

articleTitle: Performance analysis of self-similar traffic using wavelet transform
publicationTitle: 2016 Third International Scientific-Practical Conference Problems of Infocommunications Science and Technology (PIC S&T)
abstract: Traffic analysis using classical methods of queuing theory supposes independent or at least uncorrelated traffic counts. This article is about using wavelet transform for decreasing correlation in strongly correlated traffic. Also shown the transform of the probability density function of the source of traffic using two-dimensional probability density function and a “model” distribution based on cumulant analysis.

articleTitle: Designing of optimal infocommunication system
publicationTitle: 2016 Third International Scientific-Practical Conference Problems of Infocommunications Science and Technology (PIC S&T)
abstract: In recent years the study of infocommunication systems has been devoted a lot of work. However, until now not been proposed model adequately describing information and communication systems and allowing to use the entire arsenal of classic methods for analyzing nonlinear dynamic systems. The paper proposes a new approach to the analysis of the behavior of infocommunication systems with the TCP protocol - considering them as nonlinear dynamical systems that exhibit chaotic properties when defined-represented values of the parameters. The phase portraits of the studied systems, values calculated maximum Lyapunov exponent for different values of the basic parameters of the systems. The aim of the research was to find the optimal values of the parameters of infocommunication system, in which the area of performance (ie, the area of the system parameters in which it absence, chaotic phenomena exist) maximum. To achieve this goal the following tasks were solved: statement of the problem of parametric optimization of infocommunication system with the TCP protocol;- obtaining an algorithmic model of the objective function on the basis of the simulation model of infocommunication systems;- the choice of method solving the optimization problem;- the solution of the optimization problem with the selected optimization methods.

articleTitle: Enhance the functioning communication systems with a frequency hopping in the conditions of the radio electronic conflict
publicationTitle: 2016 Third International Scientific-Practical Conference Problems of Infocommunications Science and Technology (PIC S&T)
abstract: In this article the main principles of building radio station with frequency hopping spread spectrum are described. This problem is relevant because of modern powerful facilities for electronic intelligence and jamming. The prototype of the modern frequency hopping spread spectrum radio station with quadrature radio frequency processing was developed.

articleTitle: Information technology of assessing privacy of complex distributed information and telecommunication systems
publicationTitle: 2016 Third International Scientific-Practical Conference Problems of Infocommunications Science and Technology (PIC S&T)
abstract: Within the current situation in the market of IT-technologies, in terms of the growth of telecommunication technology, its development, parameterization, innovation, the need to provide the required level of security and privacy analysis is steadily increasing, in order to prevent unauthorized access to information, its blocking and malfunctions of information and telecommunication systems. The work is devoted to an actual problem of the development of the algorithm for determining the likelihood of security of information and telecommunication system of the existing threats of modern means of protection.

articleTitle: Increasing profitability of banking products at the expense of the implementation of probability assessment of clients
publicationTitle: 2016 Third International Scientific-Practical Conference Problems of Infocommunications Science and Technology (PIC S&T)
abstract: This article describes the problems of the banking market and capability to improve profitability through the introduction of probabilistic customers assessment system.
